newsitem.title: UK: UK natgas sees one more deal, bid/offer spreads wi.
newsitem.headline: UK natgas sees one more deal, bid/offer spreads wi.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures saw only a single 15-lot trade on Wednesday afternoon, in October at 10.70 pence a therm.

The trade took the total number of lots traded over the day to 30, in three separate deals. The second October trade was done at 10.70 pence a therm, down by 0.10 pence from the earlier deal but still up by 0.025 pence from the previous settlement price.
Front month August was bid at 9.20 pence and offered at 9.35 pence by the close, straddling the previous settlement level of 9.27 pence a therm. September saw the tightest range of 9.30/9.40 pence.
But the only other months with both bids and offers posted, January, February and March, saw extremely wide ranges - 17/18 pence, 17/18 pence and 12.90/14.50 pence respectively.
Even though the volumes traded were small and the bid/offer ranges were wide and infrequent, the level of activity was an improvement on the first two days of the week when no trade was done at all.
